title: Battle-destroyed GY triggers — Birdface / Keldo

cards.name: Birdface
cards.officialText: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can add 1 'Harpie Lady' from your Deck to your hand.

behavior.shuffle: persisted HMAC random stream after search

cards.name: Keldo
cards.officialText: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Target 2 cards in your opponent's GY; shuffle them into the Deck.

behavior.destination: each target's physical owner's private Deck
behavior.staleTarget: only targets still in the opposing GY move
behavior.fusionTarget: physical owner's Extra Deck, preserving the Extra Deck rule
behavior.shuffle: each affected Main Deck shuffled once with persisted HMAC

validation.workflow: Node 22; npm ci; npm run check; npm run build; evidence JSON parse; focused node:test suite

limits: The adapter is isolated and is not registered in the v9 resolver or Discord handlers.
The actual Birdface/Keldo/Harpie Lady identities are not silently admitted or certified; tests use enabled fixture identities through explicit adapter overrides.
No live Discord guild/gateway test, merge, or deployment is performed by this batch.
